title: Uber Cuts 23% of People Division as New President Takes Over
summary: Uber Technologies Inc. said it is cutting 23% of jobs in a division that includes human resources, recruitment, workplace facilities and culture, part of a move by the rideshare company’s newly promoted president Jill Hazelbaker to simplify team structure.

title: Brookfield Bets on AI at Scale Never Tested Before in $50 Billion Push
summary: Bloom Energy Corp. struggled for years to convince investors its fuel cells were a practical alternative to cheaper sources of electricity. Then Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. came along right as the AI boom ramped up.

title: Alphabet Upsizes Equity Offering to $85 Billion for AI Spending
summary: Google parent Alphabet Inc. upsized its equity raise to $84.75 billion from the $80 billion it announced just two days earlier in a bid to help fund growing artificial intelligence spending plans.

title: AI Funding Boom Reaches Muni Market With Google-Tied Deal
summary: Google parent Alphabet Inc. is poised to enter the municipal-bond market’s prepaid energy space by participating in a $1 billion transaction out of California, a major development in the evolution of a booming segment.

title: Bloomberg Wealth: Jeff Aronson
summary: Centerbridge co-founder Jeff Aronson says private credit is not a systemic risk to the US economy, despite growing concerns about the sector. He also discusses how AI is reshaping investing, while arguing that it won't replace human judgement. Aronson reflects on his journey from lawyer to distressed debt investor and explains how he went on to launch Centerbridge in 2005. Aronson sits down with David Rubenstein for the premiere episode of Bloomberg Wealth Season 6. This interview was recorded April 21 in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: SpaceX Said to Target $75 Billion in IPO at $135 Per Share
summary: SpaceX is planning to offer shares ​at $135 apiece to raise $75 ​billion in its ⁠initial public ​offering, according to people familiar with the matter, as Elon Musk rejects another Wall Street convention by setting a fixed price ahead of the marketing phase of the deal.

title: Broadcom’s $280 Billion, Four-Day Bonanza to Get Earnings Check
summary: Broadcom Inc. shares have been on a tear, adding more than $280 billion in market value in just the last four sessions. But with earnings arriving after the bell, investors will have a chance to assess whether the rally has gone too far.

title: Meta Sells AI Agent for Businesses in Push to Monetize Service
summary: Meta Platforms Inc. is selling businesses access to an artificial intelligence agent for the first time, its latest effort to generate revenue to offset the company’s hefty AI investments.

title: Bank of America Bucks AI Job Fears With 2,000 Summer Interns
summary: Bank of America Corp. is continuing to hire even as artificial intelligence and other technology tools take over jobs and cut off many traditional career paths.

title: SpaceX IPO Is About Buying Elon Musk, Ives Says
summary: Dan Ives of Wedbush Securities talks about the tidal wave of IPOs that are starting to hit the market. He says the upcoming SpaceX IPO is all about buying Elon Musk. Ives speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Former VP Mike Pence on Conservatism, AI, Donald Trump
summary: Former US Vice President Mike Pence discusses his new book, "What Conservatives Believe,” what he sees as the future for the Republican Party, regulation of artificial intelligence, and his relationship with President Donald Trump. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Europe Unveils Sweeping Tech Sovereignty Plan to Boost Chips, AI
summary: The European Union unveiled a sweeping plan to expand its domestic technology supply chains, targeting greater independence from the US and Asia in semiconductors, artificial intelligence and cloud computing.

title: 23andMe Is Back as Nonprofit Aiming to Reach 100 Million Users
summary: The founder of 23andMe Research Institute wants to reach 100 million users, an ambitious goal after the seller of DNA testing kits emerged from bankruptcy as a nonprofit.

title: Sitecore Said to Acquire Scrunch for $225 Million
summary: Sitecore A/S, the digital-experience software company, has acquired Scrunch, a customer-experience platform that helps brands improve how they appear in AI-generated search results, according to a statement reviewed by Bloomberg.

title: US Premarket Movers for June 3, 2026
summary: S&P 500 Index futures are little changed as of 7:50 a.m. in New York as growing strains on the ceasefire between the US and Iran sent oil prices higher.

title: Trump Officials Held Millions of Dollars of SpaceX Ahead of IPO
summary: SpaceX’s initial public offering will likely make President Donald Trump’s already wealthy administration even richer.

title: AI Jitters Fuel Biggest Swings in India’s IT Stocks Since 2020
summary: Shares of Indian software services companies are experiencing their sharpest swings since the pandemic, as the growing prowess of artificial intelligence fuels investor anxiety about the industry.

title: SpaceX IPO Terms Due & Trump's New Tariffs | The Pulse 6/3/2026
summary:
"The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.
Today's guests: Patrick Armstrong, Plurimi, CIO; Beata Javorcik, European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, Chief Economist; Julien Barnes-Dacey, European Council on Foreign Relations, Middle East and North Africa Programme Director. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: News Publishers Weigh Whether AI is Industry Killer or Savior
summary: The potential effects of AI dominate a meeting of global publishers

title: JPMorgan’s Lipikhina Sees Earnings Supercycle Driving US Stocks
summary: An earnings “supercycle” in the US is poised to drive stocks to more record highs, according to Nataliia Lipikhina at JPMorgan Chase & Co., fueled by heavy spending from hyperscalers and advances in agentic AI.

title: Spain Earmarks Up to €800M for Massive EU Data Center Project
summary: Spain is confident it’ll be awarded a massive artificial intelligence data center project by the EU and plans to invest as much as €800 million ($929 million) in it.

title: SpaceX Kicks Off AI IPOs Set to Rewrite the Rules of Wall Street
summary: The AI era is set to enrich Wall Street in a way different from previous technology booms.

title: Forget Tariffs, Rally Is All AI-Led Growth
summary:
US stocks struggled to build on record gains amid ceasefire tensions between the US and Iran. Growing strains on the ceasefire between the US and Iran sent oil prices higher for a third straight day. Meanwhile US President Donald Trump is proposing new tariffs of at least 10% on imports from 60 trading partners

Bloomberg Cross-Asset Strategist Ven Ram breaks down the implications of the latest tariffs' announcement, the need for the Fed to tighten and also how the Bank of England needs to act early with Bloomberg's Lizzy Burden on "Daybreak Europe." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Music Startup Suno Raises Capital at $5.4 Billion Valuation
summary: Suno Inc., a startup that enables people to make music using artificial intelligence, has raised $400 million at a valuation of $5.4 billion.

title: DeepSeek Close to Sealing $7 Billion Funding in Historic AI Deal
summary: DeepSeek is close to finalizing a deal to raise about 50 billion yuan ($7.4 billion) from investors including Tencent Holdings Ltd. and its own founder in one of China’s largest startup financings, a milestone for a domestic AI industry seeking capital to take on marquee US names like OpenAI.

title: Uber Targets Doubling Its Fleet of Electric Motorcycles in Kenya
summary: Uber Technologies Inc plans to double its fleet of electric motorcycles in Kenya by the end of the year, as the company races toward becoming a zero-emissions mobility platform globally by 2040.

title: US and Iran Exchange Strikes, Trump Begins Rebuilding Tariff Wall | The Opening Trade 6/3/2026
summary:
US stocks struggled to build on record gains as growing strains on the ceasefire between the US and Iran sent oil prices higher for a third straight day. The cautious mood follows flare-ups in the Middle East that are testing a fragile truce between Washington and Tehran, with US forces intercepting ballistic missiles and drones aimed at neighboring countries and striking an Iranian command center in response.

The US is proposing new tariffs of at least 10% on imports from 60 trading partners in President Donald Trump’s biggest move to rebuild his protectionist wall since his earlier levies were struck down by the US Supreme Court.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia CEO Pitches ‘Insane’ AI Returns to Billionaire Families
summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang touted “insane” returns for investors willing to bet on the AI boom, seeking to dispel lingering concerns around the big sums spent on artificial intelligence and its long-term profitability.

title: AI Saves Time But Most Companies Waste the Gain, Study Shows
summary: Employees across industries continue to adopt AI tools at a rapid rate, yet the technology’s impact on productivity and efficiency is uneven and muddled, according to a new study.

title: JPMorgan Lifts S&P Target on Earnings 'Supercycle'
summary: Nataliia Lipikhina, head of EMEA equity strategy at JPMorgan Private Bank, says she sees the US earnings "supercycle" to drive stocks to fresh records. "We actually just recently lifted our S&P target, and we think that the earnings growth in 2026 can be 20%," Lipikhina tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
